name: abap-util
description: Utility functions for ABAP Cloud and Standard ABAP

scripts.syfixes: find . -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_transpile: rm -rf node/output node/downport && cp -r src node/downport && abap_transpile ./node/setup/abap_transpile.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:cloud && npm run rename
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run auto_transpile && npm run unit
